profile.headline: Mobile Tech Architect | AI Engineer | Freelance Music Composer for Film, TV, Ads
profile.summary: Experienced software analyst with a successful history of delivering impactful web & enterprise applications utilizing Java, and Kotlin. Skilled in analyzing business needs and communicating requirements while delivering high-quality software solutions through the full SDLC process.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Leadership · Microsoft Office · Kotlin · JavaScript · Mobile Application Development · Java · Prompt Engineering · Prompt Design · MySQL · Process Improvement · Android Development

positions.title: UI Designer / Mobile App Developer
positions.description:
Sole UI/UX designer for this start-up company. Created a unique and modern experience for the interaction between people and the localized messaging application “Loqi”. Responsible for researching, wireframing, designing, testing, and delivering entire Android experience.
• Responsible for developing the android version of the localized messaging application.
• Responsible for designing and producing all marketing material, and social media content for 
Creative Connection Networks.
• Worked extensively with Knockout.js and Java
• Worked in Android Studio to develop native Android applications
• Designed and implemented a data warehouse for a major retailer
• Developed an ETL process to load data from multiple sources into the data warehouse
• Wrote SQL queries to extract data for analysis
• Created reports and dashboards for business users
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · Graphic Design · Android Development · Adobe Creative Suite

positions.title: Technical Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft Office · JavaScript · HTML 5 · Process Improvement

positions.title: Associate Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•	Assisted with data integration initiatives by implementing interfaces and changing work processes accordingly.
•	Ensured that developed/automated integrated processes are operational at all times.
•	Thoroughly tested all developed interfaces/applications prior to deployment in order to maximize efficiency.
•	Learned, adapted to, and worked with (integrate) disparate technologies and systems without disrupting or compromising the existing environment.
•	Assisted with validating test environments to ensure reliability and robust deployments.
•	Adequately communicated project status to senior and other project team members.
•	Created and maintained documentation on all developed applications and processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Office · SQL · HTML 5 · Process Improvement

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•	Resolved customer’s issues or concerns that may arise in the area of order fulfillment, logistics, and product quality.  
•	Participated in many marketing and promotional initiatives such as promotional flyers, and mobile kiosk set-ups.  Some call center experience.
•	Make sales and ensure superior customer service
•	Provide training for new employees
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Microsoft Office · Adobe Creative Suite
